blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training, allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. Multi-View further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input, reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. Each selected expert executes one forward pass, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained on 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. Multi-Router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility, with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on both the expert and the token.
blocks.zh: Sparse 混合专家模型(MoE)通过激活每个符号的一小群专家来扩展参数能力. 专家的选择直接影响到固定的活跃专家预算下的模型能力。 对所有专家的深入评价表明,单行道排名与专家实用性评价排名之间缺乏一致,特别是在中层和深层。 用于选择和计算的更丰富的信号会产生额外的成本:基于内部专家激活的筛选需要初步计算,而通过同一专家单独处理多个完整的表示则重复其计算. 我们提议多视频部改进多路由器的专家选择,并重新利用他们的偏好,在固定的专家预算下对专家计算进行调制。 其多路透子模块聚合 sigmoid 从独立初始化路由器得分. 这些路由器在培训期间发展出高度差异化的专家偏好,使得专家能够被选取一个路由器或几个路由器共同支持. 多维进一步利用每个被选取的专家跨路由器的相对分数,将所学到的潜在观点混合到其输入中,再用路由偏好进行选择和计算. 每个选定的专家执行一个前行传,保留主动专家计数,专家FLOP,以及所有通信量. 在经过708B道具培训的24层10B-A1B型机上,全多维尤MOE改进了下游九任务平均比基线高出1.18个百分点. 单是多路特就获得0.6个百分点的增益,并改进了路由器分数与评估的专家效用之间的排名关联,全球相对增长8.1%,单路特调整率最低的地层增长约58%. 受控混合干预显示该模型使用了取决于专家和符号的输入差异.

blocks.en: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts for each token ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2021 ) . This conditional computation enables larger language models under a limited active-computation budget. Routing scores determine which experts process each token and how their outputs are combined. The resulting capability depends on both expert selection and the computation performed by the selected experts.
blocks.zh: Sparse 混合专家模型(MoE)通过激活每个符号的一小组专家来扩展参数容量(Shazeer等,2017;Fedus等,2021). 这种有条件的计算可以在有限的活性计算预算下实现更大的语言模型. 例行评分决定了哪些专家处理每个符号,以及其产出如何合并。 由此产生的能力既取决于专家的选择,也取决于选定的专家的计算。

blocks.en: Traditional MoE uses a single routing head followed by hard top- k k selection. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals limited agreement between the router’s ranking and the ranking obtained from empirical expert-utility evaluation, especially in middle and deep layers (Fig. 2 ). Unselected experts receive no direct task-loss gradient from that token, so poor selections may become self-reinforcing. This motivates assessing experts from multiple scoring perspectives rather than relying on one router.
blocks.zh: 传统的MOE使用一个单一的路由头,然后是硬顶- k 选择. 对所有专家的深入评价表明,路由器的排名与经验性的专家实用性评价获得的排名之间,特别是在中层和深层(图2)。 未经挑选的专家不会从中直接获得任务损失梯度,因此,选择不当可能会自我强化。 这促使从多个评分角度评估专家,而不是依赖一个路由器。

blocks.en: Standard MoE uses routing scores to select experts and weight their outputs, but does not reuse them to construct expert inputs. Load-balancing methods regulate expert utilization ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , but do not themselves provide multiple assessments of each expert. Activation-based routing such as AoE obtains expert-specific signals through partial evaluations of all experts, using low-rank factorizations to control the cost ( Lv et al., 2025 ) . Evaluating multiple input representations separately would also add expert computation. The challenge is therefore to obtain multiple assessments of experts and use routing preferences to modulate their computation while preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and communication volume.
blocks.zh: 标准教育部使用路由分数来选择专家并权衡其产出,但不会再利用它们来构建专家投入. 负载平衡方法规范了专家的利用(Wang等人,2024a),但本身并不提供对每名专家的多重评估. AoE等基于活化的路由通过对所有专家的部分评价来获得专家特有的信号,利用低级的分化来控制成本(Lv等,2025.). 单独评估多种投入表述也会增加专家计算。 因此,面临的挑战是获得对专家的多重评估,并利用路径选择来调整其计算,同时保留活跃的专家计数、专家FLOP和通信量。

blocks.en: We propose Multi-View MoE, a framework that reuses router preferences to improve expert selection and modulate expert computation. Its Multi-Router submodule combines multiple assessments of a shared expert pool: independently initialized sigmoid routing heads produce scores that are summed before one top- k k selection. These routers develop highly differentiated preferences during training. Their aggregation allows experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by multiple routers to be selected. This submodule retains a shared expert input while enriching the information used for selection.
blocks.zh: 我们提出多视多视部(Multi-View MoE),一个重新使用路由器偏好以改善专家选择和调制专家计算的框架. 其多路特子模块结合了对共享专家池的多度评估:独立初始化的相克路由头产生分数,在一上-克入选前进行汇总. 这些路由器在训练期间发展出高度差别的偏好. 它们的聚合可以使专家得到一个路由器的强烈青睐,或得到多个路由器的联合支持才能被选中. 这个子模块保留了共享的专家输入,同时丰富了用于选择的信息.

blocks.en: Multi-View further uses these differentiated preferences to modulate each selected expert’s computation. The summed score alone does not retain the routers’ relative preferences: score vectors ( 0.4 , 0.1 ) (0.4,0.1) and ( 0.2 , 0.3 ) (0.2,0.3) both sum to 0.5 0.5 but express opposite preferences (Fig. 1 ). Each router is paired with a learned latent projection, and each selected expert’s raw sigmoid scores are normalized across routers to blend the views into its input before evaluation. The projections are shared across experts, while the mixing proportions depend on both the token and the expert. Mixing takes place before dispatch, and each selected expert performs one forward computation, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume.
blocks.zh: 多视图进一步使用这些有区别的偏好来调制每个选定的专家的计算. 单是总得分并不能保留路由器的相对偏好:分数矢量(0.4,0.1) (0.4,0.1) (0.2,0.3) (0.2,0.3) 两者总和为0.5,但表示相反偏好(图1)。 每个路由器都配有学习到的潜在投影,每个选定的专家的生相图分数在路由器之间正常化,以便在评价前将观点融入其投入。 预测由专家分享,而混合比例则取决于象征和专家。 混合在发送前进行,每个被选中的专家都进行一个前向计算,保留活性专家计数,专家FLOP,以及全通通信量.

blocks.en: On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained for 708B tokens, the full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 1.18 percentage points over the baseline, reaching 34.25 34.25 ; its Multi-Router submodule alone provides a 0.6 0.6 -point gain. Routing diagnostics show that this submodule improves global score–utility rank correlation by a relative 8.1 % 8.1\% , with a relative gain of approximately 58 % 58\% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment (§ 4.4 ). Measurements show distinct expert inputs for the same token. At the final MoE layer, permuting view-mixing proportions across experts while fixing expert selection and output gates raises held-out NLL by 0.01340 0.01340 nats/token; permutation across tokens for the same expert also increases NLL (§ 4.3 ). These results show that the trained model uses the correspondence between mixing proportions, experts, and tokens.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Sparse MoE layers route each token to a small subset of experts and combine their outputs ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ) . Token routing with a linear routing head and top- k k selection remains common in sparse MoE models ( Cai et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2024b ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) . Switch Transformer uses top-1 routing ( Fedus et al., 2021 ) . Recent large language models also adopt MoE architectures ( GLM-5-Team et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Approaches such as fine-grained experts with an always-active shared expert increase the flexibility of expert specialization ( Dai et al., 2024 ) . In these architectures, however, a discrete routing decision determines the active experts, which process a shared token representation.
blocks.zh: Sparse MoE地层将每个符向一个小子集的专家并结合其产出(Shazeer等,2017.). 带有线性路由头和上-克选择的托肯路由在稀有的MOE模型中仍然很常见(Cai等,2024;DeepSeek-AI等,2024b;Jiang等,2024). Switch. 变形器采用上行-1路由(Fedus等,2021年). 最近的大型语言模型也采用MOE架构(GLM-5-Team等,2026;Wang等,2026a.). 具有一贯积极性的共同专家的精干专家等办法,增加了专家专业化的灵活性(Dai等人,2024年)。 然而,在这些结构中,一个单独的路线决定决定决定的是活跃的专家,他们处理一个共同的象征性代表。

blocks.en: Router design addresses routing quality, stability, and load balance through methods including router z z -loss ( Zoph et al., 2022 ) , expert-choice routing ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) , auxiliary-loss-free balancing ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , mitigation of representation collapse ( Chi et al., 2022 ) , and attention over experts ( Wu et al., 2024a ) . Expert assignments can fluctuate during training, motivating methods for more stable routing ( Dai et al., 2022 ; Nguyen et al., 2025 ) . Router Upcycling initializes query projections and expert keys from preceding attention layers for dense-to-MoE upcycling, then sums query–key matching scores across routers before softmax selection ( Ran et al., 2025 ) . MoR uses a learnable main router to weight sub-router outputs in LoRA expert mixtures for parameter-efficient fine-tuning ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Our Multi-Router submodule sums scores from separately parameterized sigmoid routing heads during pretraining. Multi-View further uses each expert’s relative scores across routing heads to construct its input.

blocks.en: A separate line of work changes the representations processed by experts. LatentMoE computes router scores from the full hidden state and evaluates experts in a low-dimensional latent space ( Elango et al., 2026 ) . Stable LatentMoE modifies this design for training stability while retaining a single down-projection ( Kimi Team et al., 2026 ) . We build on this shared-projection architecture. MoLAE factorizes expert weights into shared latent mappings, optionally within expert groups, and expert-specific transformations ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . AoE removes the separate router: experts are ranked by the L 2 L^{2} norms of their low-dimensional internal activations, and only selected experts continue computation; low-rank factorization reduces the cost of this initial evaluation ( Lv et al., 2025 ) . MH-MoE splits projected tokens into sub-tokens that share a router and expert pool ( Wu et al., 2024b ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . Multi-Head LatentMoE instead assigns each sub-token an independent MoE module with its own router and experts ( Cui et al., 2026 ) ; SliceMoE also explores token slicing ( Vejendla, 2025 ) . MoH applies shared and routed components to attention heads rather than to the FFN ( Jin et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 单独的一行工作改变了专家处理的陈述。 后辈 教育部计算路由器从完全隐藏状态得分,并在低维潜在空间评价专家(Elango等,2026年)。 稳定列车 教育部修改了这一设计,以保持培训稳定性,同时保留单一的下投影(Kimi Team等,2026年)。 我们以这个共享预测架构为基础。 劳动和社会事务部将专家权重纳入共享的潜在制图,可选择在专家组内进行,以及专家特有的转变(Liu等人,2025b)。 AoE移除了单独的路由器:专家按L2 L^{2}的低维内部活化规范排行,只有被选中的专家继续计算;低等因子化降低了本次初步评价的成本(Lv等,2025年). blocks.en: Multi-View MoE uses K K projections of the full hidden state as a shared basis. For each selected expert, raw scores are normalized across routers to determine a token- and expert-dependent mixture before expert computation. The number of projections depends on K K , rather than on the number of experts, and expert parameters are shared across views. This changes the representation each expert receives. Prior analyses relate hidden-state geometry to expert-usage patterns ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Multi-Router retains the shared latent input of LatentMoE while aggregating multiple routing heads; Multi-View further reuses their preferences to modulate expert inputs.

blocks.en: We compare the latent-space MoE baseline, Multi-Router, and score-derived Multi-View on a 24-layer 10B-A1B backbone with top-8 routing and one always-active shared expert ( Elango et al., 2026 ) . The three configurations share the training data, token budget, backbone, and optimization settings (App. B.2 ). blocks.en: We compare the baseline and Multi-Router using the normalized expert-output norm. For each sampled token, all 256 experts process its latent input; each output’s L 2 L^{2} norm is divided by that expert’s mean norm over the sampled tokens. Spearman correlation measures agreement between the resulting expert ranking and the router scores before balancing bias (App. B.5 ). Related work also examines routing quality through expert-pathway optimization, routing-weight analysis, and expert-importance measurements ( Li et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025c ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: Multi-Router reduces loss by 4.5 × 10 − 3 4.5\times 10^{-3} with two routing heads and 5.1 × 10 − 3 5.1\times 10^{-3} with three routing heads (Table 3 ). The additional reduction of 0.6 × 10 − 3 0.6\times 10^{-3} is smaller than the observed run-pair difference of 1.2 × 10 − 3 1.2\times 10^{-3} . We use two routing heads by default. Fusion position determines whether the routing heads contribute distinct scoring functions: summing logits before sigmoid collapses them into one linear scorer (§ 3.2 ), whereas applying sigmoid to each routing head before summation preserves their nonlinear contributions. The latter distinguishes equal-mean logits with different distributions across routing heads.
blocks.zh: 多路透社将损失减少4.5×10−3 4.5\times 10×3}有两个通向头和5.1×10−3 5.1\times 10×3}有三个通向头(表3). 额外减少的0.6×10 − 3 0.6\times 10×3}比观测到的跑道相差1.2×10×3 1.2\times 10×3}要小. 我们默认使用两个路由头。 Fusion 位置决定了路由头是否贡献了不同的打分功能:在 sigmoid 崩溃之前将日志进行组合,形成一个线性记分符(§ 3.2),而将 sigmoid 应用到每个路由头之后,再进行归纳保存其非线性贡献. 后者区分了在路由头之间分布不同的等位对数.

blocks.en: Different fusion rules determine how the scoring views contribute to expert selection. Maximum fusion retains only the strongest score, whereas products and geometric means emphasize joint support. Summation accumulates bounded contributions from all routing heads, allowing either a strong response from one routing head or support across routing heads to increase the aggregate. All evaluated fusion variants reduce loss by 3.3 3.3 – 4.5 × 10 − 3 4.5\times 10^{-3} (Fig. 7 ). The operator gaps lie within the observed run-pair difference. Beyond selection, Multi-View normalizes each selected expert’s raw scores across routing heads to construct input-mixing proportions (§ 3.3 ), connecting selection with multiple routing heads to router-conditioned expert computation.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Multi-View MoE reuses routing preferences to improve expert selection and shape expert computation. Motivated by weak agreement between single-router rankings and empirical expert-utility rankings, its Multi-Router submodule combines independently initialized routing heads that learn highly differentiated preferences. Routing diagnostics show relative rank-correlation gains of 8.1 % 8.1\% globally and approximately 58 % 58\% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Multi-View further uses each selected expert’s relative scores across routing heads to blend latent views into its input before dispatch. Each selected expert runs once, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained for 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 1.18 percentage points over the baseline; its Multi-Router submodule alone provides a 0.6 0.6 -point gain. Controlled mixing interventions show that the model makes effective use of expert- and token-dependent input differences. These findings establish routing preferences as a signal for both selecting experts and shaping how they process each token.
blocks.zh: 多View MoE再利用路由偏好来改进专家选择并塑造专家计算. 由于单路排名与经验型专家-通用排名之间缺乏一致,其多路特分模块结合了独立初始化的路由头,学习出高度差别的偏好. 常规诊断显示,全球的排名相对增长为8.1% 8.1%,在单行道对接率最低的层中约为58% 58%。 多维尤进一步利用每个被选中的专家的相对分数跨出通路头,在发送前将潜在观点融入其输入. 每个选定的专家运行一次,保留主动专家计数,专家FLOP,全通通信量. 在为708B令牌培训的24层10B-A1B模型上,全多维尤MOE改进了下游九任务平均比基线高出1.18 1.18个百分点;仅其多路特子模块就提供了0.6-0.6-分增益. 控制下的混合干预措施表明,该模型有效利用了依赖专家和象征性的投入差异。 这些结论确立了路由偏好,作为选择专家和决定他们如何处理每个标志的信号。

blocks.en: A.8 Interaction with other components

blocks.en: Multi-View modifies the MoE down-projection, router, and permutation step. Attention, including multi-head latent attention (MLA) ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2024a ) , is unchanged, as is the KV cache. Hyper-connections and their manifold-constrained variant mHC use multiple residual streams with learned mixing between sublayers ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) . Multi-View accepts the resulting sublayer input h h and returns a D D -dimensional output, so these designs are architecturally compatible. Multi-token prediction (MTP) ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2024b ) adds prediction modules and a loss term, while Multi-View leaves the training objective unchanged. In our configuration, the MTP module uses a dense FFN and is not modified. The method is also compatible in design with fine-grained and shared experts, auxiliary-loss-free balancing, and dense or hash-routed early layers ( Roller et al., 2021 ) . It leaves the vocabulary, embeddings, routed and active expert counts, expert blocks, up-projection, and expert-parallel layout unchanged.

blocks.en: An existing LatentMoE checkpoint provides a possible initialization for Multi-View. View 1 retains the checkpoint’s down-projection and routing head. The remaining views are initialized from the same projection with small perturbations, and their routing heads are initialized to zero. These additional routing heads add the same constant to every expert’s raw score, preserving the raw-score ordering but generally changing normalized output gates. Keeping the balancing bias b b unchanged also preserves the actual bias-corrected selection, because the same constant is added to every entry of s ¯ + b \bar{s}+b . The views can then differentiate during continued training.

blocks.en: Each layer uses multi-head latent attention (MLA) ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2024a ) with 16 attention heads. Queries are compressed to rank 512, and keys and values share a rank-512 latent representation. Each attention head has 192 query–key dimensions without rotary embeddings, 64 decoupled rotary dimensions, and a 256-dimensional value. QK-normalization is applied, rotary embeddings use base 10 4 10^{4} , and the attention output is gated. The cache stores the 512-dimensional KV latent and the 64-dimensional rotary key for each token and layer.
blocks.zh: 每层使用多头潜在注意(MLA)(Deep Seek-AI等,2024a),有16个注意头. 查询被压缩到512级,密钥和值共享了512级的潜在代表. 每个注意力头都有192个查询-键的维度,没有旋转嵌入,64个解接回旋维度,以及256维值. QK-常态化被应用,回旋嵌入使用基础为10 4 10^{4},注意力输出为入门. 缓存存储了512维的KV潜伏和64维的回转键,用于每个符和层.

blocks.en: All 24 FFN layers are latent-space MoE layers ( Elango et al., 2026 ) , with no preceding dense FFN layers. Each token is projected from D = 1024 D{=}1024 to d = 512 d{=}512 , and 8 of 256 routed experts are activated. Each routed expert is a latent-space SwiGLU FFN with intermediate dimension 1024; one shared expert with the same intermediate dimension is always active. Expert biases are updated at rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} for load balancing ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , and the auxiliary-loss coefficient is 0.

blocks.en: Following DeepSeek-AI et al. (2024b) , one multi-token prediction module predicts one additional future token. Its FFN is a dense SwiGLU with intermediate dimension 5120. Its loss is added to the language-modeling loss with weight 0.3.

blocks.en: Per-view load measurements show how each view’s recorded weight mass is distributed across the shared expert pool. Load balancing acts once on the aggregated assignment over the N N experts (App. A.7 ), so different views may concentrate on different subsets while the aggregate load remains balanced. We therefore report, for each view, the coefficient of variation (CV) of its recorded weight mass across experts and an effective expert count exp ⁡ ( H m ) \exp(H_{m}) , where H m H_{m} is the entropy of this normalized weight mass (App. A.10 ). The aggregate load CV is 0.854 0.854 , compared with 0.862 0.862 for the baseline, and the aggregate effective count is 188.7 188.7 , compared with 187.6 187.6 out of 256 256 .
